name: HMS Pre-Tool Safety Hooks
description: Pre-tool execution guardrails for backend SQL/migration safety and frontend architecture rule enforcement.

hooks.rule: SQL queries and schema definitions on tenant tables MUST include tenant_id and hospital_id.
TypeScript `any` type is strictly forbidden. Use `unknown` and narrow with Zod.
@ts-ignore and @ts-nocheck are forbidden. Fix the type error instead.
Inline hex colors in JSX are forbidden. Use Tailwind token class names mapped from CSS variables (e.g., `bg-primary-teal` not `bg-[#0D9488]`).
Any .tsx file inside app/ that uses useState, useEffect, useCallback, useMemo, or event handlers MUST have 'use client'; on line 1.
Generic folder names `components/`, `helpers/`, `utils/`, `misc/`, `common/` are forbidden inside role-specific route groups. Use module-prefixed names like `reception_components/`, `doctor_utils/`.
All API response data must be parsed with a Zod schema before returning. Raw `res.data` direct usage without `.parse()` or `.safeParse()` is forbidden.
DPDP Act 2023: Aadhaar must never be rendered unmasked. Only `aadhaar_masked` (last 4 digits) may appear in UI. Alert if `aadhaar` field (non-masked) appears in JSX interpolation.
tenant_id and hospital_id must NEVER be read from URL params or request body for security operations. Extract only from verified JWT claims.
React Context must NEVER hold API data, loading states, or error states. Those belong exclusively to TanStack Query. Context is only for theme, sidebar, and locale.
